question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Enervate
solution:
The correct answer is "Devitalize."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Enervate" means make (someone) feel drained of energy or vitality. ((किसी को) ऊर्जा या जीवन शक्ति की कमी महसूस कराना)

 
 
• Example: *The shock of the king's death had **enervated**__ the royalist cause.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word is "Devitalize."
 
• The word "Devitalize" means deprive of strength and vigour. (शक्ति से वंचित होना)
 __
 
• Example:* The prolonged illness seemed to **devitalize**__ her, leaving her feeling weak and fatigued.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Invigorate: **to make somebody feel healthy, fresh and full of energy. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को स्‍वस्‍थ और ऊर्जस्वी बनाना, किसी का बलवर्धन करना, अनुप्राणित करना)
 
• **Boost: **to increase something in number, value or strength. (संख्‍या, मूल्‍य या शक्ति में वृद्धि करना)
 
• **Arouse: **to cause a particular reaction in people. (दूसरे व्‍यक्तियों में कोई प्रतिक्रिया विशेष जागृत करना; जगाना, उत्तेजित करना)
